chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him), in this sermon he recounted the mention of what was from him after the migration of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), then his joining him.

key_terms.هِجْرَةِ النَّبِيِّ: The migration of the Prophet to Medina

ai.seo_question: What does the introduction to Imam Ali's first sermon in Nahj al-Balagha describe?
ai.summary: This introductory note contextualizes a sermon where Imam Ali (peace be upon him) recounts his personal history and key events occurring after the Hijra, emphasizing his close companionship and eventual reunion with the Prophet Muhammad. It highlights the biographical significance of this period in establishing Ali's role and status within the early Islamic community.
